description: List the scenes in the user's Verse workspace, newest first. Use it to find a scene id when the user refers to a scene by name or date ("my villa from yesterday"), or to show what they have published; for one known scene use get_scene_status. Parameter: `limit` (1 to 100, default 20); use 5 to 10 when looking for something recent. The response always carries `total`, so you can tell whether older scenes were left out. Read-only. Includes view counts and open review comments, useful for answering "which scene gets the most views". Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

limit.description: Maximum number of scenes to return.

name: list_scenes

scenes.description: Newest first: id, link, visibility, kind, size in MB, creation time, view count and open review comments.

title: List your scenes
